## Atlas AI change summary

## Affected area
- [ ] Public website
- [ ] CMS schema / seeds
- [ ] Claims registry
- [ ] Trust/legal text
- [ ] Velo/source notes
- [ ] Future Azure placeholder
- [ ] QA / validation
- [ ] Repository security / GitHub Actions

## Security-controlled scope
- [ ] The change is limited to the stated repository purpose.
- [ ] Repository transfer, visibility change and production activation are not included unless explicitly approved.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private keys, customer-confidential data, bank/accounting data or sensitive personal data are included.

## Required checks
- [ ] Relevant tests and repository validation have passed.
- [ ] Claims registry updated where relevant.
- [ ] Bokmål/English parity considered.
- [ ] Security/privacy boundary preserved.
- [ ] New or modified GitHub Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs and use minimum permissions.
- [ ] Dependency, security and claim/evidence impacts have been reviewed.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots and generated artifacts have been checked for secret or personal-data exposure.

## Governance and release controls
- [ ] Canonical records and implementation logs are updated where required.
- [ ] Unresolved controls are marked `PENDING_REVIEW`; they are not described as implemented.
- [ ] `publicAllowed`, `purchaseAllowed`, `releaseApproved` and other fail-closed controls remain unchanged unless explicit approval evidence is included.

## Reviewer notes
Describe the security impact, evidence reviewed, rollback method and any manual GitHub settings required after merge.
